custom_instruments.manage.create_formula

With this method you can create a CustomInstrumentFormula object.

Available as lseg.data.content.custom_instruments.manage.create_formula.

create_formula(
    symbol: str,
    formula: str | None = None,
    currency: str | None = None,
    instrument_name: str | None = None,
    exchange_name: str | None = None,
    holidays: list[dict | Holiday] | None = None,
    time_zone: str | None = None,
    description: str | None = None,
    extended_params: ExtendedParams = None,
    session: Session = None,
) -> CustomInstrumentFormula

Parameters

Parameter Type Required Default Description
symbol str Yes Instrument symbol in the format "S)someSymbol.YOURUUID".
formula str | None No None Formula consisting of rics (fields can be specified by comma).
currency str | None No None 3-letter code of the currency of the instrument, e.g. GBP.
instrument_name str | None No None Human-readable name of the instrument. Maximum of 16 characters.
exchange_name str | None No None 4-letter code of the listing exchange.
holidays list[dict | Holiday] | None No None List of custom calendar definitions.
time_zone str | None No None Time Series uses an odd custom 3-letter value for time zone IDs, e.g. "LON" for London.
description str | None No None Free text field from the user to put any notes or text. Up to 1000 characters.
extended_params ExtendedParams No None If necessary other parameters.
session Session No None session=None - means default session would be used

Returns

CustomInstrumentFormula

Example

from lseg.data.content.custom_instruments.manage import create_formula
import lseg.data.content.custom_instruments as ci
response = create_formula(
    symbol="MyNewInstrument",
    formula="EUR=*3",
    holidays=[
        ci.manage.Holiday(date="1991-08-23", name="Independence Day of Ukraine"),
        {"date": "2022-12-18", "reason": "Hanukkah"},
    ],
)
